title: Assamiya Bhakhar Buranji - Bhakhatatta (অসমীয়া ভাষাৰ বুৰঞ্জী - ভাষাতত্ত্ব)
author: Prof. Dimbeshwar Neog (ডিম্বেশ্বৰ নেওগ)
description: Pioneering philological treatise on the historical linguistics of the Assamese language by Prof. Dimbeshwar Neog. It offers an in-depth analysis of the non-Aryan Tibeto-Burman and Tai-Kadai substrate in Eastern Indic phonology, notably investigating the unrounded vowels and tonal influences resulting from centuries of intimate Tai-Assamese bilingualism.
source: Jorhat: Xonali Prakashan, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.452290
